3. "باغ وجود آب حیات از تو یافت - چرخ روش قطب ثبات از تو یافت". Means: "The garden of existence, the water of life, found from you; the wheel of light, the pole of stability, found from you." So praising source of existence.

4. "هر چه جز او هست بقائیش نیست - اوست مقدّس که فنائیت نیست". Means: "Whatever besides Him has no permanence; He is holy whose annihilation is not." So about God being eternal.
